title: Disappeared Since March: Taking a Long Break Was My Best Decision Yet
why_read: A personal reflection on taking a break from coding to avoid burnout offers relatable content but has no technical substance for an engineering digest.
analysis: This post is a personal essay about a developer stepping away from side projects and content creation for several months to prioritize studies and recover from burnout. It contains no technical content, code, tools, or engineering insight, focusing instead on wellbeing and work-life balance. While burnout is a real and important topic for engineers, this particular piece offers only generic, non-specific advice about resting and stepping back. It doesn't belong in a technical digest focused on substantive engineering content.
